title: Wireless Battery: See Device Levels in Your Taskbar

facts.method: Official README and screenshot at pinned commit
facts.limits: Windows support varies by device model and connection.

scenes.say: See your wireless battery levels right on your Windows taskbar. Meet Wireless Battery.
scenes.heading: BATTERIES AT A GLANCE

scenes.say: It brings supported mice, headsets, keyboards, and controllers into one glance, without opening a pile of vendor apps.
scenes.heading: YOUR DEVICES. ONE VIEW.

scenes.say: A red number warns you when a device hits fifteen percent or less. A blue bolt shows when it is charging.
scenes.heading: LOW OR CHARGING?

scenes.say: Download the installer from the project’s GitHub releases and run it. Check the supported device list first. Not every model works.
scenes.heading: INSTALL. CHECK SUPPORT.

scenes.say: It is free and open source. Comment BATTERY and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

viewer.problem: Battery levels scattered across vendor apps
viewer.job: See supported device battery status on the taskbar

idea: See your wireless device battery levels in one Windows taskbar view.

claims.text: Shows battery levels of supported wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows taskbar.
Low battery is red at 15 percent or less; blue bolt indicates charging.
Free and open source; support depends on device model.
